method: Unique directed game-ID joins across 63 original, quote and final rows. Source short names follow the persisted directed crosswalk. All 165 original numeric strings matched the outcome parent exactly.
Qualified finals are the mutually exclusive union of 46 official parent rows and 17 official supplement rows.
Kickoff checks use retained source audits or qualified saved presentation clocks. Every observed planning cutoff was matched to its immutable original review by blob and game ID.
Use the single R91 board for comparable denominators. The two modeled gaps have prices in a later retained capture and stay outside the single-snapshot cohort.

The R91 snapshot precedes the 18 retained conditional review windows. Their cutoff checks establish chronology only. Those prices do not represent the later reviewed number, execution window or venue offer. Mixed-book display prices are exploratory only. No CLV or combined odds inferred.
